In the present case, the respondent asserts that the acquisition involves only a limited strip of land within the Right of Way (RoW) required for a highway project, as highway projects are linear infrastructure projects, where the RoW typically ranges between 15 meters for a two-lane highway and up to about 100 meters for an expressway,
